27/10/16 M

Shanghai Municipal Council.

October 25th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
A number of rebels who have not yet been paid gathered at the office for distribution of repatriation funds on the 24th inst. The Office was not opened however and they were informed by an Inspector of Police that payment would be resumed by the 28th inst.
General Yang has instructed his detectives to watch closely the movements of the rebels and on the 24th inst he received a report from them that the rebels were not showing the slightest inclination to leave Shanghai.
Two staff officers left for Nanking on the 24th inst to report there the result of the distribution of the repatriation funds.
The troops stationed at and near the Arsenal are now daily engaged in field exercises and manoeuvres. The 3rd regiment of the 37th Brigade was transferred to Woosung on the 24th inst.
Zau Kya Ziang 曹嘉祥 Vice Minister of the Navy arrived at Shanghai on the 24th inst and is living in the Naval Headquarters at the Arsenal.

Your Obedient Servant,

[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
665
27/10/16 M

上海工部局。

1916年10月25日

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

本月24日，一群尚未领到遣散费的叛军聚集在负责发放遣散费的办事处。但该办事处并未开放，一名巡官告知他们，付款将于本月28日恢复。

杨将军已指令其侦探密切监视叛军的动向，并于本月24日收到他们的报告，称叛军丝毫没有离开上海的意向。

两名参谋人员于本月24日前往南京，汇报遣散费发放的结果。

驻扎在兵工厂及其附近的部队目前每日进行野外演习和操练。第三十七旅第三团已于本月24日调往吴淞。

海军次长曹嘉祥（Zau Kya Ziang）于本月24日抵达上海，现居住在兵工厂的海军司令部。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]
总探长。

警务处总监。
